content:
A small change can sometimes make a big difference. For users with a large number of pre-loaded beta apps, that's especially true of Apple's latest TestFlight update.

Apple has just updated TestFlight for iPhone, iPad, Mac and more. The new version 4.3 adds the ability to "search for apps with a search bar."

A quick comparison with version 4.2.2 reveals the difference: TestFlight now features a search bar at the bottom of the iPhone app and at the top of the Mac sidebar.

If you only have a handful of pre-loaded beta apps, the change may seem basic, but for those with extensive catalogues of beta software, the addition of search functionality is a long-awaited update.

The update also surfaces more apps in the "previously tested" category, so the usual bug fixes and performance improvements are likely included as well.

Apple's TestFlight app can be downloaded from the App Store, and is available for iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Vision Pro and Apple TV.
